Securities</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Decree(s) </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Circular(s)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>II. DEFINITIONS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Fund”</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Fund management company”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means Fund Management Company………….
  that is established under the License for establishment and operation
  No…………………………. issued by the State Securities Commission of Vietnam (“SSC”)
  on………….(date), Enterprise Registration Certificate No………………….issued
  by………….on…………(date). The Fund Management Company …………..is authorized to
  manage the fund and perform the rights and obligations prescribed
  in............of this Charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Supervisory bank”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>(hereinafter referred to as
  Bank………….) means the Bank…………… that is established under the Establishment
  License No………………issued by……….. on…………. (date) and Certificate of securities
  depository registration No. …. issued by SSC, and provides the following
  services: (i) management and depositing of securities and documents
  certifying the fund’s lawful ownership of assets; economic contracts and
  documents relating to the fund's assets, and supervision of the fund’s
  operations; (ii) supervision of the fund management company’s management of
  the fund's assets.     Rights and obligations of the supervisory bank are prescribed
  in ……. of this Charter.   </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Audit company”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the audit company
  performing auditing works for the fund as designated by the General Meeting
  of Investors, that is the audit company…………………., an accredited independent
  audit company performing annual auditing of assets of the investment
  fund.........   </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Charter of the fund….”  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>includes this document, attached
  annexes and other lawful revisions (if any). </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Prospectus”</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Supervision contract”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means a contract that is signed
  by and between the fund management company and the supervisory bank, and
  approved by the Fund’s General Meeting of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Investor” </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means a domestic or foreign individual
  or organization that holds fund certificates.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“General Meeting of Investors”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the general meeting of
  voting investors that is held on a regular or ad hoc basis to ratify by
  voting important issues relating to the fund. The General Meeting of Investors
  is the supreme governing body of the fund.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Fund’s representative board”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>is composed of representatives of
  investors who are appointed by the General Meeting of Investors to act on
  behalf of investors in supervising operations of the fund, the fund
  management company and the supervisory bank.  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Charter capital”</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Certificate of investment
  fund…..”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means a security that certifies
  an investor’s ownership of a stake in the fund. Face value per fund
  certificate is VND 10.000.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“ETF creation unit”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>includes at least 100.000 ETF
  certificates. The ETF creation unit is the trading unit used in exchange
  transactions between an ETF and its authorized participants/investors. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Selling/offering price”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the price that the investor
  must pay to buy a fund unit.  The selling/offering price is equal to the face
  value (determined in the initial public offering) or the net asset value
  (NAV) per fund unit plus the issuance fee as prescribed in the fund’s
  charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“redemption price” (if any)&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the price that the fund
  management company must pay to investors for a repurchased fund unit. The redemption
  price is equal to the NAV per fund unit minus the redemption fee as
  prescribed in the fund’s charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Management fee” </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“issuance/redemption fee” (if
  any)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the service fee paid by an
  investor when buying/selling a fund unit from/to the fund. The
  issuance/redemption fee is calculated as a percentage of the NAV per fund
  unit specified in this charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Fund’s dividends”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the fund’s profit that
  remains after deducting all legitimate expenses and is divided to investors
  in proportion to their holdings according the decision of the General Meeting
  of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Fiscal year”  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means a 12-month period starting on
  January 01 and ending on the December 31 of a calendar year. The first fiscal
  year of the fund shall start from the date on which the Fund obtains the certificate
  of fund establishment registration from SSC and end on December 31 of the
  same year.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“NAV”</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means total value of assets and
  investments owned by the fund minus all of its debt obligations determined at
  the valuation date.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Valuation date”</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“fund certificate trading date”
  (if any)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the day on which the fund
  management company, on behalf of the fund, creates and redeems fund
  certificates or creation units from authorized participants/investors
  according to the fund’s trading mechanism.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“closing time of order book” (if
  any)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means the final time when a
  distribution agent receives investors’ trading orders which shall be executed
  on the fund certificate trading day. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Authorized participant” (if any)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means a securities company that
  is licensed to provide securities brokerage and proprietary trading services
  or a depository bank that has entered into an agreement on ETF establishment
  with the fund management company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“real estate management unit”
  (for a real estate fund)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>means a reputable and qualified
  enterprise that provides real estate management services and is authorized by
  the fund management company…….. to maintain, preserve, manage and operate the
  real estate under a real estate management agreement.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>“Other terms”</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter I</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>GENERAL PROVISIONS </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 1.
Fund’s name and address</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Full name in
Vietnamese: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Full name in
English: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Abbreviated name:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Address:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 2. Fund’s
operating duration </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 3.
Fund’s organizational rules</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund’s
charter capital raised from its initial public offering is VND……………. This
amount is divided into………… fund certificates/creation units. Face value per
fund certificate is VND 10.000.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Investors
contribute capital in VND by bank transfer to the fund’s account opened at the
supervisory bank.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Maximum number
of fund certificates/ creation units to be sold/offered (if any):</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Any changes in
the maximum value of assets mobilized or the maximum number of fund
certificates/creation units shall be decided by the General Meeting of
Investors and reported to SSC.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 5.
Appointment of representative in charge of capital mobilization and offering of
fund certificates</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The legal
representative of the fund management company shall be appointed as the
representative in charge of performing capital mobilization and offering of
fund certificates to the public. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 6. Fund
management company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Fund management
company: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- License for
establishment and operation No.: </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Headquarters
address:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Telephone
number:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Fax:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 7.

Transfer agent
service provider (if any): </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Name of service
provider:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- License for
establishment and operation No……………. issued by………… on…………(date); Certificate of
