background:white'><b>Chapter II</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>  INVESTMENT OBJECTIVES, POLICIES AND LIMITS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 9.
Investment objectives</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 10.
Investment strategies</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Investment
strategies</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Investment
fields/sectors</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Types of assets
in which the fund is permitted to invest</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. The structure
of investment portfolio (of the real estate securities investment company)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 11.
Investment limits </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund shall
comply with the investment limits for the corresponding type of fund specified
in the Circular providing guidance on operation and management of securities
investment funds.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Investment
limits to be exceeded and reasons therefor</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The fund
management company shall adjust the investment portfolio in conformity with the
investment limits specified in Clause 2 of this Article within ........
month(s) from the occurrence of such excess.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Where the fund
management company fails to comply with the investment limits prescribed by law
or the fund’s charter, it shall assume responsibility to adjust the investment
portfolio within 15 days from the occurrence of excess of such investment
limits. In this case, the fund management company shall incur all costs arising
from transactions performed to adjust the investment portfolio and losses (if
any).&nbsp;Any profits earned will be accounted for as the fund’s profits.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 12.
Borrowing, lending and margin trading</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Borrowing,
lending, repo transactions, margin trading and short sale of the fund shall
comply with provisions of providing guidance on operation and management of
securities investment funds for the corresponding type of fund.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 13.
Investment selection methods</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Methods for
selecting investments in debt instruments.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Methods for
selecting investments in shares.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Methods for
selecting investments in bonds.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. Methods for
selecting investments in other assets.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 14. </b><b>Management
of real estate in investment portfolio </b>(for a real estate investment fund) </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 15. Asset
transactions of real estate investment fund</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Real estate
transactions of the real estate investment fund</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Conditions to
be satisfied for conducting real estate transactions with people with relevant
interests</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter III</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 16.
Investors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Investors of
the fund include domestic and foreign organizations and individuals that own at
least ………….. fund certificates. Investors shall bear neither legal liability
nor any liabilities other than those for the number of fund certificates they
own.  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Institutional
investors include economic and social organizations that are recognized by the
law of Vietnam. The investor who is a judicial person shall appoint a legal
representative for their owned fund certificates. In case of appointment,
dismissal or replacement of this legal representative, a written notice bearing
the signature of the investor’s authorized representative must be given.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 17.
Rights and obligations of investors  </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Investors shall
have the following rights and obligations: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Rights and
obligations specified in Article 101 of the Law on Securities;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Right to equal
treatment; each fund certificate will confer upon the owner equal rights, obligations
and interests;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Right to freely
transfer fund certificates, except transfer restriction cases as prescribed by
law and in the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Right to access
periodically and irregularly disclosed information about the fund’s operations;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>dd) Obligation to
fully pay for fund certificates within the time limit specified in the fund’s
charter and prospectus, and assume responsibility for debts and other
liabilities which are equal to the value of payments for fund certificates;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Other rights
and obligations as prescribed in the Law on Securities and the fund’s charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Investors or
groups of investors holding at least 5% of total outstanding fund certificates <i>or
a smaller ratio prescribed by the fund’s charter</i> shall have the following
rights: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Access and
extract minutes of meetings and resolutions of the fund’s representative board,
annual financial statements and reports on the fund’s operations made by the
supervisory bank;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Request the
fund management company to convene an extraordinary General Meeting of
Investors in the following circumstances:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The fund
management company or supervisory bank infringes upon investors’ rights, fails
to fulfill their obligations, or makes decisions beyond their authority prescribed
in the fund’s charter or supervision contract or delegated by the General
Meeting of Investors, and thus causes damage to the fund;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The term of
office of the fund’s representative board has expired for more than 06 months
without holding a new election;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Other cases
prescribed in the fund's charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Request the
fund management company and supervisory bank to provide explanations about
issues concerning the fund’s assets as well as management and trading thereof. Within
15 days from the receipt of the request, the fund management company or
supervisory bank must give a response to the requesting investor;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>dd) Perform other
rights and obligations as prescribed in the fund's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Investors or
groups of investors holding at least 10% of total outstanding fund certificates
<i>or a smaller ratio prescribed by the fund’s charter </i>shall have the right
to nominate candidates to the fund’s representative board. Nomination
procedures shall be carried out in accordance with regulations laid down in the
Law on Enterprises on nomination of candidates to Boards of Directors by
shareholders or groups of shareholders holding at least 10% of total ordinary
shares.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. The request of
the investors or groups of investors mentioned in Clauses 2, 3 of this Article
must be made in writing and include full name, contact address, number of ID
card, citizen’s identity card, passport or another valid personal
identification paper; name, headquarters address, nationality, number of
enterprise registration certificate or establishment decision of the institutional
investor; the number of owned fund certificates and time of ownership of each
investor, total fund certificates of the group of investors and their holdings
in the fund; requests and recommendations; grounds and reasons therefor. If an
extraordinary General Meeting of Investors is requested as prescribed in Point
b Clause 2 of this Article, the request must be accompanied by documents
stating the reasons for the extraordinary General Meeting of Investors; or
documents and evidences about violations committed by the fund management
company or supervisory bank or about decisions issued beyond their authority
specified in the fund’s charter or supervision contract. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 18. Conditions
for investors conducting ETF exchange transactions</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Each investor
must own component securities and meet the requirements regarding weight and
quantity of each security symbol included in the basket of component securities
as notified by the fund management company when exchanging component securities
for fund certificates, unless cash payment is made as prescribed.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The investor
must own at least ….. creation units when conducting a transaction to exchange
fund certificates for component securities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Investors may
only conduct exchange transactions at authorized participants where their
securities trading accounts are opened and after they have entered into service
contracts for conducting exchange transactions.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Investors shall
also meet other conditions laid down in this Charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 19.
Investor registers  </b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The primary
investor register and the subsidiary investor register shall, inter alia,
contain the following information:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Name and
headquarters address of the fund management company; name and headquarters
address of the supervisory bank; full name of the fund; listed securities
symbols of the fund (if any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Total fund
certificates to be offered, total fund certificates offered, structure, and
total capital raised;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) List of
investors/authorized participants (for an ETF), specifying: full name, number
of ID card, citizen’s identity card, passport or another valid personal
identification paper, and contact address (if the investor is an individual);
full name, abbreviated name, number of enterprise registration certificate or
establishment decision, and headquarters address (for an institutional
investor); number of securities depository account (if any); number of the
investor’s account or sub-account enclosed with the number of nominee account;
the number of owned fund certificates/ ETF creation units; ownership
percentage; subscription date and payment date; accompanied by certification
given by Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC) of
component securities baskets of each authorized participant or investor which
are held for transfer to the ETF.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Date of the
investor register.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The fund
management company and transfer agent service provider must always have
adequate information about the ownership of each investor, including those
trading via nominee accounts.  Information about assets of investors in the
primary investor register is the proof for certifying their ownership of fund
certificates.  With regard to an open-end fund, an investor's ownership shall
be established from the time when the information about its/his/her ownership
is updated in the primary investor register.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 20.
Transfer of certificates of closed-end funds and private funds</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company must not redeem fund certificates at the request of investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Investors shall
transfer fund certificates by conducting transactions on the Stock Exchange (SE)
after the fund has been listed (for a closed-end fund or real estate investment
fund) or as prescribed by law and the fund’s charter (for a private fund).</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company must arrange the fund certificate trading for investors. Fund
certificate trading shall be arranged on a periodical basis.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Trading
frequency </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Subscription
order </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Redemption
order</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. Switching order
(if any)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>6. Closing time of
order book </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>7. Methods of
settlement  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 22.
Partial redemption and suspension of trading of open-end fund certificates and
ETF certificates</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 23.
Exchange of component securities baskets for ETF creation units or vice versa</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 25.
Selling and redemption prices  </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Initial
offering price </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The selling
price of a fund unit is equal to the NAV per fund unit calculated at the fund
certificate trading day minus the redemption fee (if any).</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The redemption
price of a fund unit is equal to the NAV per fund unit calculated at the fund
certificate trading day plus the issuance fee (if any).</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Redemption fee</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. Issuance fee</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>6. Switching fee</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 26.
Inheritance of fund certificates</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Fund
certificates shall be inherited in conformity with the Law on Inheritance. The
fund shall only accept lawful heirs and shall not bear liability for any disputes
arisen from the inheritance or heirs.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 27.
Solutions for managing fund’s losses</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter IV</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>GENERAL MEETING OF INVESTORS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 28.
General Meeting of Investors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The General
Meeting of Investors is the supreme governing body of the fund. Any investors
whose names have been specified in the investor register before the meeting is
convened are entitled to attend the General Meeting of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The General
Meeting of Investors is convened by the fund management company to make
decisions on:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Revisions to
the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) The fundamental
changes in the fund’s investment policies and objectives; increase of service
fees paid to the fund management company and the supervisory bank; replacement
of the fund management company or the supervisory bank;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Full or partial
division, consolidation, merger or dissolution of the fund; changes in the
charter capital of a closed-end fund; changes in the fund’s operating period;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>dd) Election or
dismissal of the chairperson and members of the fund’s representative board;
remunerations and operating costs of the fund’s representative board; selection
of accredited audit organization to audit the fund’s annual financial
statements, and independent valuation firm (if any); ratification of financial
statements and annual reports on the fund’s assets and operation;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Consideration
and handling of violations committed by the fund management company,
supervisory bank and the fund’s representative board if they cause damage to
the fund;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>g) Request for
transaction documents or records presented by the fund management company and
supervisory bank at the General Meeting of Investors;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>h) Other rights
and obligations as prescribed by law and this charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The agenda of
the General Meeting of Investors shall be prepared by the fund management
company in accordance with regulations on agenda of the General Meeting of
Shareholders laid down in the Law on Enterprises. At least 07 days before the
General Meeting of Investors, the fund management company must provide the
agenda and relevant documents for SSC, and disclose information about the
General Meeting of Investors, including reasons and objectives of the meeting.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. The annual
General Meeting of Investors shall be convened within 04 months from the end of
the fiscal year. At the request of the fund’s representative board, the time
limit for convening the annual General Meeting of Investors may be extended by
up to 06 months from the end of the fiscal year and such extension must be
notified to SSC. If permitted in the fund’s charter, the annual General Meeting
of Investors may be held by carrying out a questionnaire survey.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 29.
Extraordinary General Meeting of Investors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company shall convene an extraordinary General Meeting of Investors
in the following circumstances:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) The fund
management company, or the supervisory bank, or the fund’s representative board
deems it necessary for the fund’s interests;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Other cases
prescribed in the fund's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The
extraordinary General Meeting of Investors shall be convened within 30 days
from the receipt of the request for extraordinary General Meeting of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. In case the
fund management company refuses to convene the General Meeting of Investors as
prescribed in Clause 2 of this Article, it shall assume legal responsibility to
make compensation for any damage to the fund. If the fund management company
continues refusing to convene the General Meeting of Investors as prescribed in
Clause 2 of this Article, within 30 following days, the fund’s representative
board or supervisory bank shall convene the General Meeting of Investors on
behalf of the fund management company according to procedures laid down in this
charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 30.
Conditions and procedures for meeting and ratifying decisions of General
Meeting of Investors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The meeting of
the General Meeting of Investors shall be conducted when it is participated by
a number of investors representing more than 50% of total votes. Investors may
cast their votes directly or through their authorized representatives or as
absentees (by mail, fax, email, online meeting, electronic voting or another
electronic voting form) as prescribed in this charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. In case the
conditions for conducting the first meeting specified in Clause 1 of this
Article are not fulfilled, the second meeting will be convened within 30 days
from the planned opening date of the first meeting. In this case, the General
Meeting of Investors shall be conducted regardless of the number of
participating investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The General
Meeting of Investors shall ratify resolutions by voting or questionnaire
survey.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Resolutions of
the General Meeting of Investors on the issues in Points b, c Clause 2 Article
28 of this charter shall be ratified by voting at the meeting. In this case, a
resolution shall be ratified when it is voted for by a number of investors
representing more than 65% of total votes of all participating investors <i>or
a higher ratio as prescribed in the fund’s charter.</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. A decision of
the General Meeting of Investors shall be ratified at the meeting when it is
voted for by a number of investors representing more than 50% of total votes of
all participating investors <i>or a higher ratio as prescribed in the fund’s
charter,</i> except the case specified in Clause 4 of this Article.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>7. In case of
questionnaire survey, a decision of the General Meeting of Investors shall be
ratified when it is voted for by a number of investors representing more than
50% of total votes of all voting investors <i>or a higher ratio prescribed in
the fund’s charter.</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>8. The fund
management company and the fund’s representative board shall ensure that all
resolutions of the General Meeting of Investors are conformable with laws and
the fund’s charter. If a decision of the General Meeting of Investors is
contrary to laws and this charter, investors’ opinions about this case shall be
obtained by convening the General Meeting of Investors or questionnaire survey.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 31.
Objection to decisions of General Meeting of Investors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Investors of an
open-end fund that object to a decision, which has been ratified by the General
Meeting of Investors, on the issue in Point b or c Clause 2 Article 28 of this
charter may request the fund management company to redeem their fund certificates
or move to other funds of the same type managed by that fund management
company. The request must be made in writing and specify the investor’s name
and address, quantity of fund units, reasons for redemption or transfer to
another fund. The investor’s request shall be sent to the headquarters of the
fund management company or the distribution agent within 15 days from the date
on which the decision is ratified by the General Meeting of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Within 45 days
from the date of announcement of meeting results by the General Meeting of
Investors, the fund management company shall complete the redemption or
switching of fund certificates for investors objecting to the decision of the
General Meeting of Investors as prescribed in Clause 1 of this Article. In this
case, the redemption price shall be determined according to the NAV per fund
certificate on the latest fund certificate trading day after the fund
management company receives the investor’s request, and the investor shall not
pay redemption or switching fees.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter V</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>FUND’S REPRESENTATIVE BOARD </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 32.
Fund’s representative board</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund’s
representative board is composed of …… members elected by the General Meeting
of Investors or voted for by investors by questionnaire survey. Designation or nomination
of candidates to the fund’s representative board must comply with the following
provisions:</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) In case the
quantity of candidates is not sufficient, the current fund’s representative
board may nominate additional candidates or hold a nomination as prescribed by
the fund’s charter.  Nomination mechanism or methods for nomination of
additional candidates by the current fund’s representative board must be
clearly published and ratified by the General Meeting of Investors before the
nomination; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Procedures for
designation or nomination of candidates to the fund’s representative board</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>( comply with
regulations on members of Board of Directors and Board of Directors laid down
in the Law on Enterprises and the Law on Securities)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. At least two
thirds of members of the fund’s representative board are independent members
according to the following rules:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) They are
neither related persons nor authorized representatives of the fund management
company or the supervisory bank;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) They meet other
requirements laid down in the fund’s charter (if any).</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The fund’s
representative board shall have (for a public fund):</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) At least 01
independent member who has professional qualifications and experience in
accounting and auditing;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) At least 01
independent member who has professional qualifications and experience in
securities investment analysis or asset management; </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The representative
board of the real estate investment fund that is operating in the form of a
closed-end fund must not comply with Point a of this Clause but shall have at
least 01 independent member who has professional qualifications and experience
in real estate business and valuation.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 33.
Term of office and eligibility requirements of members of fund’s representative
board</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The term of
office of a member of the fund’s representative board shall not exceed 05 years
without term limit. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Eligibility
requirements for members of the fund representative’s board</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>(comply with
regulations on members of Board of Directors and Board of Directors laid down
in the Law on Enterprises and the Law on Securities)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The following
persons shall not be elected as members of the fund’s representative board:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Persons
specified in regulations on members of Board of Directors and Board of
Directors laid down in the Law on Enterprises and the Law on Securities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) A person who is
a member of more than 05 representative boards of public funds or Boards of Directors
of public securities investment companies;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Other cases
prescribed in the fund's charter.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Represent the
interests of investors; take actions in accordance with regulations of law to
protect the interests of investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Approve the
valuation manual which is used for determining the fund's NAV; list of
quotation service providers and credit institutions as prescribed in …….of this
charter; approve transactions as prescribed in …….of this charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Decide the
levels of profit distributed according to the profit distribution plan
specified in the fund’s charter or approved by the General Meeting of
Investors; profit distribution time and method.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Make decisions
on issues which cannot be agreed upon between the fund management company and
the supervisory bank in accordance with regulations of law.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. If permitted in
the fund’s charter and authorized by the latest General Meeting of Investors,
the fund’s representative board is entitled to make decisions on the issues
specified in …… of this charter.  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>6. Request the
fund management company and the supervisory bank to provide adequate and timely
documents and information about fund management and supervision activities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>7. Perform other
duties as prescribed in the fund's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 35.
Rights and obligations of members of fund’s representative board</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Perform rights
and obligations of members of the fund’s representative board according to
regulations on members of Board of Directors of listed companies laid down in
the Law on Enterprises and the Law on Securities, and the fund’s charter. </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Fully
participate in meetings of the fund’s representative board and comment of the
raised issues.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 36.
Chairperson of fund’s representative board</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The General
Meeting of Investors shall elect one of independent members of the fund’s
representative board as its Chairperson.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Chairperson of
the fund’s representative board shall have the following rights and
obligations:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Plan the
activities of the fund’s representative board;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Draw up agenda
and prepare documents for meetings of the fund’s representative board’ convene
and chair the meetings;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Supervise the
implementation of decisions of the fund’s representative board;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Perform other
rights and obligations prescribed in the fund's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 37.
Appointment, dismissal and addition of members of fund’s representative board</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 38.
Procedures for operation of fund’s representative board</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. In case the
Chairperson of the fund’s representative board is absent or unable to perform
his/her rights and obligations, he/she shall authorize another member of the
fund’s representative board to perform his/her rights and obligations.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. In case no
member is authorized, one of the remaining independent members of the fund’s
representative board shall be elected as the interim Chairperson of the fund’s
representative board under the rule of unanimity. A new Chairperson of the
fund’s representative board shall be elected in the next meeting of the General
Meeting of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 39.
Meetings of fund’s representative board</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The meeting of
the fund’s representative board shall be held at least every ……. month(s) or at
the request of the fund management company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Procedures for
conducting the meeting, meeting agenda and relevant documents must be provided
for members at least……… day(s).</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. A meeting of
the fund’s representative board shall be convened when it is participated by at
least two thirds of its members of which more than 50% are independent members.
Members who do not directly participate in the meeting may vote by
questionnaire survey or in other form as prescribed in the fund’s charter. A
decision of the fund’s representative board shall be ratified when it is voted
for by the majority of its members and the majority of its independent members.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Decisions of
the fund’s representative board shall be ratified by voting at the meeting,
questionnaire survey or another method specified in the fund’s charter.  Each
member of the fund’s representative board has one vote.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 40.
Minutes of meeting of fund’s representative board</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter VI</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>FUND MANAGEMENT COMPANY</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 41.
Standards of fund management company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 42.
Rights and obligations of fund management company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Obligations of
the fund management company</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Rights of the
fund management company</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 43.
Termination of rights and obligations to fund</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company shall terminate its rights and obligations to the fund in
the cases specified in this charter and as prescribed by law regulations in
force.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. In the case
specified in Clause 1 of this Article, rights and obligations of the fund
management company to the fund shall be transferred to another fund management
company in accordance with regulations of law in force.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter VII</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>SUPERVISORY BANK</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 45.
Standards of supervisory bank</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The supervisory
bank shall be selected by the fund management company and must satisfy all
requirements laid down in Article 116 of the Law on Securities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. A supervisory
bank must be independent and separate from the fund management company to which
its supervision services are provided. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 46.
Rights and obligations of supervisory bank</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Obligations of
the supervisory bank</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Always act for
the best interests of the fund’s investors; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Bear liability
for damage caused to the fund due to the bank’s mistake;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Provide
services of supervision and depository of assets of the fund as prescribed by
relevant laws, the supervision contract and the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Separate assets
of the fund from those of the fund management company, those of other funds,
those of other clients of the supervisory bank and those of the supervisory
bank;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>f) Ensure and bear
liability for the fund’s assets in case of authorization of a secondary
depository institution;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>g) Supervise or
calculate the NAV of the fund [frequency] in conformable with the law and the
fund’s charter, ensuring that the fund's NAV is accurately calculated;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>h) Settle
securities transactions in conformity with lawful directions from the fund
management company. The supervisory bank is entitled to refuse such directions
if it has reasonable grounds for determining that such directions are unlawful
or contrary to the fund’s charter. In case of refusal, a written notice indicating
reasons of such refusal must be sent to the fund management company. A copy of the
notice shall be sent to SSC;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>i) Carry out
regular comparison between assets of the fund and those of the fund management
company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>k) Make settlement
for reasonable and legitimate costs of the fund according to lawful directions
of the fund management company, ensuring that such costs are conformable with regulations
of law and provisions of the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>l) Make settlement
to the fund’s investors when the fund management company redeems fund
certificates from investors, or when the fund distributes profits to investors,
or the fund liquidates its assets in case of dissolution, or in other cases as prescribed
by the law and the fund’s charter. Such settlement shall be made according to lawful
directions of the fund management company provided that it must be made in
conformity with provisions of the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>m) Keep a separate
record of changes in total issued fund certificates, the number of fund
certificates owned by each investor, name, contact address, nationality,
address, and update any changes. </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 47.
Supervision activities of supervisory bank</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The supervisory
bank shall only supervise operations of the fund management company which are
relevant to the fund that is the bank’s client. During performance of
supervision tasks, the supervisory bank shall:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Cooperate with
the fund management company to periodically review internal regulations on
principles and methods for determination of the fund’s NAV; supervise the
determination of NAV; inspect and ensure that the NAV per fund certificate and
NAV per creation unit have been calculated correctly and accurately in
accordance with regulations of law and the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Supervise
investments and transactions in assets of the fund, inspect to ensure that the
invested assets and investment portfolio are conformable with regulations on
investment limits, loan limits laid down in relevant laws and the fund’s
charter; supervise asset transactions between the fund and the fund management
company and its related persons to ensure their compliance with regulations of
law and the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The supervisory
bank shall promptly report any detected signs of violations against the law to
SSC and notify them to the fund management company within 24 hours from the
detection of such violations, and request the fund management company to take
remedial actions within the prescribed time limit;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Supervise the
process and results of the merger, consolidation, dissolution and asset
liquidation of the fund;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Supervise to
ensure the legitimacy and that assets of the fund are used to pay costs in
accordance with regulations of law and the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>dd) Supervise
other operations of the fund management company in managing the fund’s assets
as prescribed in Article 116 of the Law on Securities, relevant regulations
laid down in the legislative documents providing guidelines for implementation
of the Law on Securities and the fund’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Verify reports
on NAVs, investments and investment portfolio of the fund, which are prepared
by the fund management company.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. When receiving
written request from the fund management company, the supervisory bank shall
promptly, adequately and accurately provide necessary information to the fund
management company and accredited audit organization so that they can fully
perform their rights and obligations to the fund in accordance with regulations
of law and the fund’s charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. The supervisory
bank is entitled to request the fund management company to provide necessary
and relevant documents and information, and information about issuers which the
securities investment fund or company invest in so that it can fully perform
rights and obligations to the securities investment fund or company as
prescribed by law. The supervisory bank shall protect the confidentiality of
all documents and information provided by the fund management company as
prescribed by law.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. If the fund
management company must pay compensation for damage caused to the fund and/or
its investors, the supervisory bank shall cooperate with the fund management
company to make timely and full payments to the fund and/or its investors
according to lawful directions of the fund management company.  The supervisory
bank shall jointly bear responsibility with the fund management company to pay
compensation to the fund or securities investment company for any damage caused
by the supervisory bank’s failure to fully and promptly supervise investments,
calculation of NAV and other operations of the fund in accordance with
regulations of law. The compensation shall be determined according to terms and
conditions of the signed contract or agreement between the fund management
company and the supervisory bank. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 48.
Termination of supervisory bank’s rights and obligations to fund</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The supervisory
bank shall terminate its rights and obligations to the fund in the cases
specified in this charter and as prescribed by regulations of law in force.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. In the case
specified in Clause 1 of this Article, rights and obligations of the
supervisory bank to the fund shall be transferred to another supervisory bank
or custodian bank as prescribed by law.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter VIII</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>RELEVANT SERVICE PROVIDERS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 49.
Authorized activities </b>(outsourced services) </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Criteria on
competence, system, personnel, experience and professionalism.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Criteria on
organizational structure of the department in charge of providing relevant
services of the authorized party, operational procedures, and reporting and
report approving system.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 51.
Responsibilities of relevant service providers  </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Rules for
performing authorized activities</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Scope of
operation, functions and duties of authorized parties</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Requirements
regarding documents, records and database</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. The authorized
party shall perform authorized works in an effective and prudent manner, and protect
confidentiality of all information relating to investors and other partners of
the fund management company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. The authorized
party shall provide the fund management company with independent auditor’s
reports on authorized activities to serve the inspection and supervision by the
fund management company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 52.
Responsibilities of fund management company for authorized activities</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Before entering
into service contracts with the authorized party, the fund management company
must carry out the due diligence and examine material facilities of such authorized
party in order to ensure that it has adequate material facilities, technical
solutions, operational process, and experienced and qualified personnel for performing
authorized activities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Carry out regular
inspections to ensure that authorized activities have been prudently and safely
performed in conformity with regulations of law, this charter, and that the
quality of services provided by the authorized party is conformable with
criteria and requirements of the fund. The fund management company is entitled
to employ independent consultants or services provided by other professional
organizations that are operating under the law to fulfill this responsibility.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Maintain
employees with experience, qualification and skills necessary for supervising,
identifying and handling risks arisen from authorized activities in an
effective way; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. Establish procedures/systems
to ensure that the fund management company, independent auditing organization
and competent regulatory authorities are able to access necessary information
for supervising the performance of authorized activities, evaluating and
managing risks arisen from such activities at any times;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>6. The fund
management company shall bear the full responsibility for such authorization.  The
fund management company must ensure the continuity of authorized activities
which must not cause any interruption and influence on investors’ investment;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>7. Provide
relevant information to the authorized party in a sufficient, timely and
accurate manner in order that the authorized party can fully and punctually
fulfill its rights and obligations within the scope of authorization;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>8. Adequately,
punctually and accurately keep directions, requests and documents sent to the
authorized party for performing authorized activities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 53.
Termination of authorization</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter IX</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'>(for a real estate securities investment fund)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 54.
Standards of independent valuation firm</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 55.
Rights and obligations of independent valuation firm</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 56.
Valuation activities of independent valuation firm</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter X</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>DISTRIBUTION AGENTS AND NOMINEES</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter XI </b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>AUDITING, ACCOUNTING AND REPORTING</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 57. Standards
and replacement of audit company </b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>A fiscal year is a
12-month period starting on January 01 and ending on the December 31 of a
calendar year. The first fiscal year of the fund shall start from the date on
which the Fund obtains the certificate of fund establishment registration from
SSC and end on December 31 of the same year.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 59.
Accounting   </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The fund shall
apply Vietnam’s accounting policies and comply with other regulations on the
fund’s accounting promulgated by competent authorities. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 60.
Financial statements </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 61.
Other reports </b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter XII </b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>FUND’S NET ASSET VALUE (NAV)</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 62.
Determination of fund’s NAV  </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company shall formulate the valuation manual which shall be
consistently applied during the management of fund’s assets. The fund
management company shall determine the fund’s NAV, the NAV per fund certificate
and the NAV per ETF creation unit in accordance with regulations of law and the
fund’s charter.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. The fund’s NAV
must be determined on a periodical basis of…… and publicly disclosed in
accordance with regulations of law on disclosure of information on securities
market.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 63.
Rules and criteria for selection and replacement of quotation service providers</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 64. Rules,
procedures and methods for determination of fund’s NAV</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 65. Compensation
to investors and fund (for an open-end fund)</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company shall pay compensation to the fund and/or its investors when
it has miscalculated the fund’s NAV as follows: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) The error is at
least 0,75% of the NAV of the bond fund;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) The error is at
least 1,00% of the NAV of another fund.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. If the fund has
been undervalued, the compensation paid to the fund and investors shall be
determined as follows: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) If an investor
has bought fund certificates before the miscalculation of the fund’s NAV and
sold such fund certificates within the miscalculation period, the compensation
shall be determined according to the error margin and the number of fund
certificates sold; </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. If the fund has
been overvalued, the compensation paid to the fund and investors shall be
determined as follows: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) If an investor
has bought fund certificates within the miscalculation period and still holds
such fund certificates after this period, the compensation shall be determined
according to the error margin and the number of fund units bought and held by
that investor;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) The
compensation paid to the fund shall be determined according to the error margin
and the number of fund units which have been offered before the miscalculation
period and redeemed within such period by the fund.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter XIII </b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>OFFERING OF ADDITIONAL FUND CERTIFICATES,
INCREASE/DECREASE OF CHARTER CAPITAL</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'>(for a closed-end fund or private fund)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 66.
Offering of additional fund certificates, increase/decrease of charter capital</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund may
raise its capital by means of calling additional capital from its investors
through issuance of call option for fund certificates. The call option may be
transferred.  If an existing investor fails to exercise the call option for
fund certificates, the fund management company is entitled to offer unsold fund
certificates to other investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Offering of
fund certificates to raise capital of a closed-end fund must comply with
relevant law provisions.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Decrease of
charter capital (for a private fund)</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter XIV</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>ISSUANCE FEES, INCOMES AND OPERATING COSTS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 67.
Management, depository and supervision fees</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 68.
Fund’s incomes  </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 69.
Fund’s operating costs</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 70.
Other costs </b>(including salaries, bonuses and other remunerations paid to
members of the fund’s representative board, audit service fees, valuation fees
and other costs)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 71.
Performance bonus and benchmark index (not applicable to open-end funds)</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 72.
Profit distribution   </b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>RESTRUCTURING AND DISSOLUTION OF FUND</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 73.
Consolidation, merger of funds (applicable to open-end funds and closed-end
funds)</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The
consolidation and merger of funds shall be performed in the cases prescribed by
the law and approved by the General Meeting of Investors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The
consolidation and merger of funds requires an approval from SSC.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 74.
Full and partial division of an open-end fund</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Provisions on full
and partial division of the fund</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. The full and
partial division of the fund requires an approval from SSC.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 75.
Dissolution of fund</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Provisions on
dissolution of the fund</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter XVI</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>SETTLEMENT OF CONFLICTS OF INTEREST </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 76.
Managing conflicts of interest between the fund and other funds, trustors of
the fund management company, and between the fund and the fund management
company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. The fund
management company must:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- separate
investment strategies and objectives of each fund that it manages;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- separate its
assets from those of the funds that it manages and trustors; separate assets of
funds that it manages from each other.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. All securities
transactions conducted by members of the Board of Directors, members of the
Board of Members, President of the fund management company, members of the
executive board, members of the Board of Controllers, Controllers, fund
managers and employees of the fund management company must be reported and
controlled in accordance with the fund’s charter and relevant laws in force.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. Establish
systems for internal control, risk management and supervision of conflicts of
interests within the fund management company.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Chapter XVII</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 77. 
Information disclosure and provision of information for investors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 77.
Revisions to fund’s charter</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Revisions to
this charter are subject to decision of the General Meeting of Investors of the
securities investment fund. Such revisions to the fund’s charter must be
reported to SSC.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Where any
regulations of law relating operations of the securities investment fund which
are not yet referred to in this charter or new regulations of law are contrary
to the provisions of this charter, such regulations shall implicitly prevail
and govern operations of the securities investment fund.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>Article 78.
Registration and implementation of fund’s charter</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. This charter
consists of ……Chapters and ……Articles which have been approved by the General
Meeting of Investors on………(date) that has also ratified the full text of this
charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. This Charter is
made into……originals of the same legal effect, including……. This charter is
enclosed with the following Annexes:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Annex No. 1.1.
Commitment of the fund management company</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Annex No. 1.2.
Commitment of the supervisory bank</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Annex 1.1</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>COMMITMENT OF THE FUND MANAGEMENT COMPANY</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Fund management
company: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>License for
establishment and operation No. ……... issued by the State Securities Commission
of Vietnam (SSC) on..........................(date)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Enterprise
registration certificate No……………… issued by………. on……</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The fund
management company undertakes to fulfill the following commitments to the
fund………….: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Strictly comply
with regulations of law and the fund’s charter during its management of the
fund.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. Manage the fund
in an effective, honest and wholehearted manner in conformity with the fund's
investment objectives for the best rights and interests of investors.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>4. Pay service
fees to the supervisory bank and other relevant service providers as prescribed
in the fund's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. Provide the
following information to the supervisory bank on a periodical basis:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a. Reports on business
operation and financial statements of the fund, investor registers and quantity
of fund certificates owned by investors;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b. Reports
relating to the fund or its assets and investment portfolio;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c. Reports on
determination of the fund’s NAV, the NAV per fund unit and the NAV per creation
unit;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d. Information
relating to management of the fund’s operation and other obligations. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>6. Provide, free
of charge or with reasonable fees, copies of the fund’s charter (and enclosed
annexes) and the prospectus (and enclosed annexes) to investors at their
request.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>7. Not make
investment in securities or assets from which the fund management company shall
directly, or its related persons, gain or involve in interests, except for
cases permitted by law.  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>8. Not use its
positions in management of the fund for the purpose of directly or indirectly
gaining interests for itself or its related persons or causing damage to
legitimate interests of investors.  </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>10. Provide, free
of charge or with reasonable fees, copies of annual reports and other reports
of the fund for investors at their request.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>11. Provide, free
of charge or with reasonable fees, copies of the supervisory bank’s annual
reports on evaluation of the fund’s management by the fund management company for
investors at their request.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>12. Ensure that
the information disclosed by the fund management company or its representative
is adequate, truthful and accurate without omission of events affecting investors’
rights and interests, those affecting disclosed information, and the
information to be disclosed as prescribed by law, and must not cause
misunderstanding to investors. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>13. Sufficiently
provide necessary information for the independent audit organization for
fulfilling auditing works in an effective and timely manner.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>14. Promptly
submit reports to SSC if the record of the fund’s credits/debits of the fund
management company does not match that of the supervisory bank.    </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>15. Convene the
General Meeting of Investors in accordance with regulations of law.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>(GENERAL)
  DIRECTOR OF FUND MANAGEMENT <br>
  COMPANY <br>
  </b><i>(Signature, full name and seal)</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>Annex 1.2</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b>COMMITMENT OF THE SUPERVISORY BANK</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Supervisory bank:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>License for
establishment and operation No:. …. issued by
……………on.......................(date)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Certificate of
securities depository registration No.: ……. issued by the State Securities
Commission of Vietnam (SSC) on......................... (date)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The supervisory
bank undertakes:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. To strictly
comply with regulations of law and the fund’s charter during performance of its
supervision activities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. To ensure that
a fund management company is employed at all times to work for the fund’s
interests. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>3. To perform
duties of the supervisory bank to the fund in a wholehearted, honest and
cautious manner.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>5. To separate
assets of the fund from those of the supervisory bank, the fund management
company, other funds, and other clients of the supervisory bank.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>6. To supervise
the fund’s investment portfolio, valuation of the fund’s assets, determination
of the fund’s NAV, the NAV per fund certificate and the NAV per creation unit
in accordance with regulations of law in force and the fund’s charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>7. To fulfill
supervision duties so that the fund management company cannot misuse its
positions to perform activities that directly or indirectly generate interests
to the fund management company or its related persons or cause damage to
legitimate interests of investors.  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>8. To ensure that
the fund is annually audited by an independent audit company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>AUTHORIZED

  </b><i>(signature, full name and seal)</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
