with the fund’s charter/ the charter of the securities investment company and
relevant laws;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- I assume the
full responsibility for the truthfulness and accuracy of all attached
documents.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>DECLARANT<br>

background:white'><b><span style='font-size:12.0pt'>APPENDIX XIV</span></b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'>ASSET VALUATION METHODS <br>
<i>(Enclosed with the Circular No. 98/2020/TT-BTC dated November 16, 2020 of
the Minister of Finance)</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>A – Values of
assets</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>No.</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Type
  of asset</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Rules
  for determination of trading price on the market</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Cash and cash equivalents,
  money market instruments </b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Cash (VND)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Cash balance on the day preceding
  the valuation date.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>2.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Foreign currencies </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Value exchanged to VND according to
  the current exchange rate announced by credit institutions that are licensed
  to trade foreign currencies on the day preceding the valuation date.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>3.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Term deposits</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Value of deposits, plus accrued
  interests, up to the day preceding the valuation date.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>4.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Purchase price, plus accrued
  interests, up to the day preceding the valuation date.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>5.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Non-interest instruments, including:
  treasury bills, bonds, financial instruments and other non-interest
  instruments</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The quoted price posted on the
  trading system of the Stock Exchange (SE); in the absence of the quote price,
  the price shall be determined according to the discounted cash flow based on
  the bid-winning interest rate or another interest rate designated by the
  fund’s representative board/Board of Directors of the securities investment
  company and the time period of holding such instruments.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Bonds </b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>6.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Listed bonds</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The average quoted price posted
  on the trading system, or otherwise called according to SE’s internal
  regulations, on the latest trading day before the valuation date, plus
  accrued interests;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- In case there is no transaction
  made over a period longer than 15 days prior to the valuation date, one of
  the following prices shall apply: </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ The face value, plus accrued
  interest; or&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ The price determined by
  employing the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of
  Directors of the securities investment company.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>7.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Unlisted bonds</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The quoted price (if any)
  posted on the quotation systems, plus coupon interest rate, up to the day
  preceding the valuation date; or </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The purchase price, plus
  accrued interest; or&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The face value, plus accrued
  interest; or&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The price determined by
  employing the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of
  Directors of the securities investment company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Shares </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>8.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Shares listed on SEs</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The closing price, or otherwise
  called according to SE’s internal regulations, of the latest trading day
  before the valuation date;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- In case there is no transaction
  made over a period longer than 15 days prior to the valuation date, one of
  the following prices shall apply: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ Book value; or</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ Purchase price; or</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ The price determined by
  employing the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of
  Directors of the securities investment company.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>9.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Shares of public companies that
  have been registered for trading on UpCom</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- In case there is no transaction
  made over a period longer than 15 days prior to the valuation date, one of
  the following prices shall apply: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ Book value; or</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ Purchase price; or</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ The price determined by
  employing the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of
  Directors of the securities investment company.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>10.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Shares which are suspended from
  trading or delisted, or the registration for trading of which is cancelled</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>One of the following prices shall
  apply: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- Book value; or</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- Face value; or</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>11.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Shares of issuers that are under
  dissolution or bankruptcy </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>One of the following prices shall
  apply: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- 80% of the liquidation value of
  such shares determined at the date of preparation of the latest balance sheet
  before the valuation date; or </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The price determined by
  employing the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of
  Directors of the securities investment company.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>12.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Other shares or stakes</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The market price is the mean
  price of successful transactions conducted on the latest trading day before
  the valuation date which is provided by quotation service providers.&nbsp; In
  the absence of quotations, one of the following prices shall apply:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ Book value; or</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>+ The price determined by
  employing the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of
  Directors of the securities investment company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Derivatives </b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>13.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Listed derivatives </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The closing price, or otherwise
  called according to SE’s internal regulations, of the latest trading day
  before the valuation date.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>14.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Listed derivatives of which no
  transaction is made over a period longer than 15 days prior to the valuation
  date</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The price determined by employing
  the method approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of Directors of
  the securities investment company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Other assets</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Real estate </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The price determined by the
  valuation firm at the nearest time</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>16.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Other assets which are permitted
  for investment </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>- The market price is the mean price
  of successful transactions conducted on the latest trading day before the
  valuation date which is provided by quotation service providers.&nbsp; In the
  absence of quotations, the price shall be determined according to theoretical
  model approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of Directors of the
  securities investment company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Notes: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Accrued interest
refers to the amount of interest that has accumulated from the last interest
payment up to, but not including, the valuation date;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Book value of a
share is determined on the basis of the latest audited or reviewed financial
statements.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Liquidation
value of a share is equal to the owner’s equity of the issuer divided by total
number of outstanding shares.&nbsp;&nbsp; </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The date stated
in this part of the Appendix is construed as a calendar date.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>B- Global
exposure from derivative contracts</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>1. Global exposure
refers to the value exchanged to cash in which the fund/securities investment
company is liable to perform the contract. The global exposure is determined on
the basis of the market value of the underlying asset, settlement risk, market
fluctuations and position liquidation period.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>2. When
calculating the global exposure, the fund management company shall be allowed
to apply:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The netting
rules for the same type of underlying securities, for example, the long
position of call option on security XYZ shall reduce (offset) the global
exposure of the short position of call option on that security XYZ; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The netting
rules for derivative positions and spot position of a security, for example, the
long position (held) of security XYZ shall offset (reduce) the global exposure
of the short position of call option on that security XYZ;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Other rules as
prescribed in international practices, which must ensure the risk
management.&nbsp; </p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>No.</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Type
  of asset</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>1.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Stock options (buying put option,
  selling put option, selling call option)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The market value of an option
  position<sup>1</sup> adjusted by the option’s delta = Number of contracts x Quantity
  of shares on each contract x Current market value of shares x delta value<sup>2</sup></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>2.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Bond options (buying put option,
  selling put option, selling call option)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The market value of option
  position<sup>3</sup> adjusted by the option’s delta = Number of contracts x
  Face value x Current market value of bonds x delta value</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>3.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Index futures contracts </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The market value of a futures
  position = Number of contracts x Value per index point x Current index value </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Bond futures contracts </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The market value of a futures
  position = Number of contracts x Notional contract value x Market value of
  cheapest to deliver bond </p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>5.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Other contracts</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Employing the model which is
  jointly selected and agreed by the fund management company and the supervisory
  bank, and approved by the fund’s representative board/Board of Directors of
  the securities investment company </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>__________________</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><sup>1</sup>&nbsp;If
the fund holds a long position, the market value may be increased by adding the
option premium. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><sup>2</sup>&nbsp;Delta
is the first derivative of the value of the option with respect to the
underlying security’s price.&nbsp; In simple cases, delta value is 1. In case
of complicated options, delta value shall be determined by the fund management
company and/or the supervisory bank after obtaining approval from the fund’s
representative board.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><sup>3</sup>&nbsp;If
the fund holds a long position, the market value may be increased by adding the
option premium. </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;background:white'><b><span
style='font-size:12.0pt'>APPENDIX XV</span></b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;background:white'>INVESTOR
IDENTIFICATION INFORMATION COLLECTED BEFORE OPENING FUND CERTIFICATE TRADING
ACCOUNT <br>
<i>(Enclosed with the Circular No. 98/2020/TT-BTC dated November 16, 2020 of
the Minister of Finance)</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>A – Contents of investor
identification information</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Distribution agents can design
their own investor identification information forms or apply the form designed
by the fund management company or the supervisory bank provided that such a
form must, inter alia, include the following information:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Investor details: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the investor is a Vietnamese
citizen:&nbsp; Full name; number of ID card or citizen identity card; contact
address; telephone; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the investor is a
foreigner:&nbsp; Full name; nationality; date of birth; number of Passport or
other valid personal identification paper; temporary address in Vietnam (if
any); contact address in foreign country within 06 months before entering
Vietnam; telephone; securities trading code; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>If a trading account is co-owned
by multiple investors, details about each investor must be adequately provided
as above.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the investor is an
organization:&nbsp; Full name and abbreviated name; headquarters address;
telephone number and fax number; number and date of issue of the establishment
license/investment certificate/enterprise registration certificate;
establishing authority; business sectors or investment fields; details about
the legal representative (same as details about an individual investor
mentioned above);</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Beneficiary details: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the beneficiary is a
Vietnamese citizen:&nbsp; Full name; number of ID card or citizen identity
card; contact address; telephone; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the beneficiary is a
foreigner:&nbsp; Full name; nationality; date of birth; number of Passport or
other valid personal identification paper; temporary address in Vietnam (if
any); contact address in foreign country within 06 months before entering Vietnam;
telephone; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the beneficiary is an
organization:&nbsp; Full name and abbreviated name; headquarters address;
telephone number and fax number; number and date of issue of the establishment
license/investment certificate/enterprise registration certificate; establishing
authority; business sectors or investment fields; details about the legal
representative (same as details about an individual beneficiary mentioned
above).</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Name and signature of the
employee in charge of approving the account opening.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>B. Investor identification
methods</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Use reliable original documents
and data for identifying and verifying the investor identification information,
including:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the investor is an
individual:&nbsp; ID card or citizen identity card or latest exit/entry visa or
unexpired Passport or other valid personal identification paper bearing the
investor's photo stamped by a competent authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- If the investor is an
organization:&nbsp; The establishment license or decision, decisions on change
of name, partial or full division or merger, enterprise registration
certificate, tax registration certificate, audited financial statements;
decision on appointment of General Director (Director) and Chief
Accountant.&nbsp; </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Collect information about the
investor from entities (including other distribution agents and supervisory
banks) that have maintained or established relationship with the investor, and
compare such information with the one provided by the investor;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The reporting entity may hire or
cooperate with other entities to verify the investor identification
information.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) In case of multiple investors
concerned, the distribution agent shall apply investor identification methods
to each investor;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) The distribution agent shall,
depending on its business natures and based on the level of money-laundering
risks associated with each investor, apply other additional investor
identification methods.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'><b><span style='font-size:12.0pt'>APPENDIX XXIV</span></b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;
background:white'>SAMPLE OF REPORT ON CHANGES IN NET ASSET VALUE (NAV)<br>

background:white'>To: The State Securities Commission of Vietnam (SSC)&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Name of the fund
management company:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>-&nbsp;Name of the
supervisory bank: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Name of

period: from………………to……………………</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>I. For a fund
of which NAV is daily calculated</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>&nbsp;No.</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Indicators</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Reporting
  period</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Previous
  period</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>I</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Net Asset Value (NAV)</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>per fund</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>1.2</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>per ETF creation unit</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>1.3</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>per fund certificate</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>2</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Foreign investors’ holding
  ratio (not applicable to listed funds)</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>2.1</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Quantity of fund certificates</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Total value</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>2.3</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Holding ratio</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>II. For a fund
of which NAV is calculated on another periodical basis/weekly report on changes
in NAV</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>&nbsp;No.</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Reporting
  period</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Previous
  period</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>I</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Net Asset Value (NAV)</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>1</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Value at the beginning of
  period</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>&nbsp;</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>1.1</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>1.2</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>per ETF creation unit</i></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>1.3</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>per fund certificate/share</i></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>2</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Value at the end of period</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>2.1</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>per fund/securities investment
  company</i></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>2.2</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>2.3</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>per fund certificate/share</i></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>3</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Changes in NAV during the
  period, including: </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>3.1</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Changes due to investments
  made by the fund/securities investment company during the period </i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>3.2</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Changes due to redemption or
  additional offering of fund certificates during the period</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>3.3</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>4</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Changes in NAV per fund
  certificate/share, compared with the previous period</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>5</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Highest/lowest NAV within the
  latest 52 weeks</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>5.1</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>5.2</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Lowest NAV</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>6</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Foreign investors’ holding
  ratio (not applicable to listed funds)</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>6.1</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>6.2</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Total value</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>6.3</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Holding ratio</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>II</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Market value </b>(the closing price
  at the end of the trading session in the reporting day) of a fund
  certificate/a share of the securities investment company (applicable to
  listed funds/securities investment companies)</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>1</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Value at the beginning of
  period</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>2</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Value at the end of period</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>3</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Changes in the market value
  during the period, compared with the previous period</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>4</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Difference between the market
  value of a fund certificate/a share of the securities investment company and its
  NAV (applicable to listed funds and securities investment companies)</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>4.1</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Absolute difference *</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>4.2</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Relative difference (discount
  (-)/ premium (+))**</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>5</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Highest/lowest market value
  within the latest 52 weeks</b></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>5.1</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Highest value</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><i>5.2</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>Lowest value</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>&nbsp;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Notes: * This
difference equals the market value minus (-) NAV at the same time</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>** This difference
equals the difference between the market value and NAV at the same time divided
by NAV</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>AUTHORIZED
  REPRESENTATIVE OF SUPERVISORY BANK <br>
  </b><i>(signature, full name and seal)</i></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>(GENERAL)
  DIRECTOR OF FUND MANAGEMENT <br>
  COMPANY <br>
  </b><i>(Signature, full name and seal)</i></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center;

(6 months/whole year)</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>1. Information
about the fund/securities investment company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Name and
business type of the fund/ securities investment company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Investment

period (if any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>h) Contents of the

Reporting on
operations of the fund/securities investment company </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Information
about the investment portfolio and the NAV of the fund/securities investment
company determined at December 31<sup>st</sup> of the latest 3 years (if any).
To be specific:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The investment
portfolio of the fund/securities investment company, sorted by business
sectors/ fields and product types (stocks, bonds, etc.) (details about the
entire portfolio by ticker symbol are not required);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- NAV of the
fund/securities investment company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- NAV per fund
unit/per share; number of outstanding fund certificates/shares of the
securities investment company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The
highest/lowest NAV per fund unit/ per share of the securities investment
company in the year</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Total profits of
the fund/ the securities investment company, including detailed information
about profits accrued from the growth in securities price (capital gains) and
profits accrued from yields on securities (dividends, coupons, deposit
interests, etc.) (income value);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>-&nbsp;Distributed
profits per fund unit/ per share of the securities investment company (net
value and gross value) in the reporting period, including profits distributed
in cash or by fund units/shares of the securities investment company; Time of
profit distribution; NAV per fund unit/ per share of the securities investment
company determined before and after the profit distribution;&nbsp;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- The operating
expense ratio of the fund/ the securities investment company and explanations
about the operating expense differences of the fund/ the securities investment
company (determined at the end of the 2<sup>nd</sup> quarter and at the end of
the fiscal year);</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Information
about loans and amounts payable of the securities investment company (if any),
repo/reverse repo transactions.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Profit
indicator of the fund/ the securities investment company:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Average annual
profit of the fund/securities investment company earned during the reporting
period shall be determined:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>(i) For the period
of 12 months (01 year), up to the reporting date, (or commencing on the
establishment date of the fund/securities investment company and ending on the
reporting date if the fund/securities investment company has an operating
period less than a year); or </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>(ii) For the
period of 36 months (03 years), up to the reporting date, (or commencing on the
establishment date of the fund/securities investment company and ending on the
reporting date if the fund/securities investment company has an operating
period less than 3 years); or</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>(iii) For the
period of 60 months (05 years), up to the reporting date, (or commencing on the
establishment date of the fund/securities investment company and ending on the
reporting date if the fund/securities investment company has an operating
period less than 05 years); </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Other
comparison criteria which must comply with the following rules: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Methods and
rules for determination of value of assets and profits are consistently
applied, publicly announced and audited by another independent organization; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Data and figures
are provided by an independent organization.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>3. Reporting on
management of assets by the fund management company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The report on the
management of assets of the fund management company shall include the following
contents:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Explanations
about the replacement of the fund management company (if any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Explanations
about the fulfillment of investment objectives by the fund/securities
investment company (if the annual report of the fund/securities investment
company is submitted);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Comparison
between the profits earned by the fund/securities investment company and the
benchmark portfolio’s profits, underlying indexes specified in the prospectus
of the same reporting period (via graph);&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Comparison
between the profits earned by the fund/securities investment company and the
benchmark portfolio’s profits, underlying indexes specified in the prospectus
in the prospectus for the period of 05 recent years, up to the reporting date
(via graph);&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Description of
investment strategies which have been applied by the fund/securities investment
company during the reporting period. If the investment strategies applied
during the period are different from those specified in the prospectus,
explanations about such difference and assessment of advantages and
disadvantages of the investment strategies applied during the period shall be
provided;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>f) Description of
the difference between the investment portfolio of the fund/securities
investment company at the reporting time and that in the year preceding the
reporting year;&nbsp; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>g) Analysis on
operating results of the fund/securities investment company on the basis of
comparison between the NAV per fund unit/share of the securities investment
company (after adjustment of the distributed profits, if any) in this reporting
period and that in the previous reporting period;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>i) Information
about full/partial division of a fund unit in the period (if any); impacts of
such division and NAV per fund unit (after the division);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>k) Cases in which
rights and benefits of holders of fund certificates/shareholders of the
securities investment company are influenced; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>l) Information
about transactions made with individuals who have related rights and benefits
(if any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>m) Other information
(if any).</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>In case of a real
estate securities investment company/fund, the following information must be
provided:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Information
about the actual status and operating capacity of the real estate during the
period. Information about real estate transactions (buying-selling) during the
period;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Assessment of
the real estate management service provider; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Information
about valuation of the real estate during the period. Description of difference
between the original price and actual value of the real estate after
revaluation performed during the period; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>4. Reporting on
operations of the supervisory bank </b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>a) Explanations
about the replacement of the supervisory bank (if any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Depositing of
assets of the fund/securities investment company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Compliance with
investment limits and loan limits as prescribed by law, charter of the
fund/securities investment company and prospectus;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Determination
of NAVs as prescribed by law, charter of the fund/securities investment company
and prospectus;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Offering of
additional fund certificates/shares of the securities investment company and
redemption of fund certificates as prescribed by law, charter of the
fund/securities investment company and prospectus;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>e) Distribution of
profits of the fund/securities investment company in conformity with investment
objectives of the fund/securities investment company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>If the supervisory
bank gives an opinion that the fund management company fails to comply with the
law, the charter of the fund/securities investment company and the prospectus
with respect to the aforesaid contents, detailed information about such events
must be provided, including influences on holders of fund
certificates/shareholders of the securities investment company, including
former and potential fund certificate holders/shareholders.&nbsp;&nbsp; The
supervisory bank should propose remedial measures and solutions for preventing
similar circumstances that may occur in the future. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'><b>5. Reporting on
authorized activities&nbsp; </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>The fund
management company must prepare a report on assessment of quality of services
rendered by other entities (authorized parties) such as transfer agent
services, fund management services, NAV valuation services, etc. with the
following contents:&nbsp; </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>b) Registration of
ownership of assets (for a real estate securities investment company);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>c) Impacts (if
any) of authorized activities on the profits and level of risks incurred the
fund/securities investment company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>d) Total costs for
performing authorized activities paid to the authorized party (in case the

divided by its average NAV in the same year.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>-&nbsp; Expense
ratio of the fund/securities investment company shall be determined using the
following formula: </p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Expense
  ratio (%)</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Total
  expenses of the fund/securities investment company x100%</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Average
  NAV in the year</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>In case the
fund/securities investment company has an operating period less than a year,
the operating expense ratio shall be determined using the following formula:</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Expense
  ratio (%)</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>=</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Total
  expenses x 365 x 100%</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Average
  NAV in the reporting period × operating period of the fund/securities
  investment company (counting from the licensing date)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>- Portfolio
turnover rate of the fund/securities investment company is determined using the
following formula:</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Portfolio
  turnover rate (%)</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>(Total
  value of buy-in portfolio + total proceeds of sell-out portfolio) x100%</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>2
  x Average NAV in the year </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>In case the
fund/securities investment company has an operating period less than a year, the
portfolio turnover rate shall be determined using the following formula:</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>Portfolio
  turnover rate (%)</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>=</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>(Total
  value of buy-in portfolio + total proceeds of sell-out portfolio × 365 x100%</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'>2 x
  Average NAV in the reporting period × operating period of the fund/securities
  investment company (counting from the licensing date)</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>Where:&nbsp;<i>Average
NAV in the year of the fund/securities investment company </i>is the sum of its
NAVs as at calculation dates divided by the number of NAV calculation days in
the year; Total value of buy-in portfolio and total proceeds of sell-out
portfolio are total buy-in/sell-out value for investment activities of the
fund. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt;background:white'>&nbsp;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>(GENERAL)

<style>
   
    
    #FavoriteFolderfrom ul
    {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        max-height: 200px;
    overflow: auto;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #b7bec5;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    }
    #FavoriteFolderfrom li
    {
        list-style-type: none;
        padding: 5px;
    }
    #FavoriteFolderfrom li .Fcheckbox
    {
        float: left;
        margin-right: 5px;
    }
    #FavoriteFolderfrom li a
    {
       color: red;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 11px;
    margin-left: 5px;
    }
    #FavoriteFolderfrom li .Ftext
    {
      display:none;
    }
    
    .GridBaseVBCT .left-col {width:600px}
     .GridBaseVBCT .left-col .nq{width:560px}
</style>
<div id="FavoriteFolderfrom" title="Chọn thư mục lưu trữ" style="display: none;">
    <input id="FavoriteLawID" type="hidden" value="" />
    <ul  style='max-height: 300px;'>
        </ul>
         <span>Thư mục cha: </span><select
        id="fdParent" style="height: 26px;">
        <option value="0">Chọn thư mục cha</option>
    </select> 
    <input id="txtFolder" style="height:20px" type="text" placeholder="Tên thư mục"/>
    <button type="button" class="ui-button ui-widget ui-state-default ui-corner-all ui-button-text-only AddFolder"
        role="button" aria-disabled="false">
        <span class="ui-button-text">Tạo thư mục</span></button>
</div>
<script type="text/javascript" language="javascript">

    $(document).ready(function () {
        $("#FavoriteFolderfrom").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            height: "auto",
            width: 500,
            resizable: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lưu trữ": function () {
                    luutrufolder();
                }
            }
        });

        $(".AddFolder").click(function myfunction() {
            if ($("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() == "") {
                alert("Bạn phải nhập tên thư mục");
                return false;
            }
            var params = "FolderName=" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val();

            $.ajax({ 'url': '/page/ajaxcontroler.aspx',
                'data': params + '&action=AddFolder',
                'type': 'POST',
                success: function (response) {
                    if (response != "") {
                        if (response.substr(0, 3) == "Err") {
                            alert(response.substr(3));
                        }
                        else {
                            var items = $.parseJSON(response);
                            if (items["ParentID"] == "0") {
                                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul").append("<li><input class='Fcheckbox' name='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' fid='" + items["ID"] + "' id='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' type='checkbox' checked='checked'> <label for='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' flid='" + items["ID"] + "' parentid='" + items["ParentID"] + "'>" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() + "</label> <a FID='" + items["ID"] + "'  onclick='removeFolder(this)'>Xóa</a></li>");
                                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").append("<option value='" + items["ID"] + "'>" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() + "</option>");

                                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").html("<option value='0'>Chọn thư mục cha</option>");
                                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul li label").each(function myfunction() {
                                    if ($(this).attr("parentid") == "0") {
                                        $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").append("<option value='" + $(this).attr("flid") + "'>" + $(this).html() + "</option>");
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                            else {
                                $("#Fcheckbox-" + items["ParentID"]).parent().append("<div style='padding-left: 20px;padding-top: 10px;'><input class='Fcheckbox' name='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' fid='" + items["ID"] + "' id='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' type='checkbox' checked='checked'> <label for='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' flid='" + items["ID"] + "' parentid='" + items["ParentID"] + "'>" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() + "</label> <a FID='" + items["ID"] + "'  onclick='removeFolder(this)'>Xóa</a></div>");
                            }
                            $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val("")
                            $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul").scrollTop(10000)
                        }
                    }
                },
                error: function (response) {
                    alert(response);
                }
            });
        });
    });

    function editFolder(val) {
        var FolderID = $(val).attr("FID");


        var parent = $(val).parent();
        parent.find("label").hide();
        var Tfl = parent.find("input[type=text]");
        Tfl.show();
        Tfl.focus();
        $(val).hide();

        Tfl.blur(function () {
            if (Tfl.val() == "") {
                alert("Bạn phải nhập tên thư mục");
                Tfl.focus();
                return false;
            }
            else {
                var params = "FolderID=" + FolderID + "&FolderName=" + Tfl.val();
                $.ajax({ 'url': '/page/ajaxcontroler.aspx',
                    'data': params + '&action=UpdateFolder',
                    'type': 'POST',
                    success: function (response) {
                        if (response != "") {
                            if (response.substr(0, 3) == "Err") {
                                alert(response.substr(3));
                            }
                            else {
                                $(val).show();
                                Tfl.hide();
                                parent.find("label").html(Tfl.val());
                                parent.find("label").show();

                                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").html("<option value='0'>Chọn thư mục cha</option>");
                                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul li label").each(function myfunction() {
                                    if ($(this).attr("parentid") == "0") {
                                        $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").append("<option value='" + $(this).attr("flid") + "'>" + $(this).html() + "</option>");
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    error: function (response) {
                        alert(response);
                    }
                });
            }
            return false;
        });

        Tfl.keypress(function (event) {
            if (event.keyCode == 13) {
                if (Tfl.val() == "") {
                    alert("Bạn phải nhập tên thư mục");
                    Tfl.focus();
                    return false;
                }
                else {
                    var params = "FolderID=" + FolderID + "&FolderName=" + Tfl.val();
                    $.ajax({ 'url': '/page/ajaxcontroler.aspx',
                        'data': params + '&action=UpdateFolder',
                        'type': 'POST',
                        success: function (response) {
                            if (response != "") {
                                if (response.substr(0, 3) == "Err") {
                                    alert(response.substr(3));
                                }
                                else {
                                    $(val).show();
                                    Tfl.hide();
                                    parent.find("label").html(Tfl.val());
                                    parent.find("label").show();

                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").html("<option value='0'>Chọn thư mục cha</option>");
                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul li label").each(function myfunction() {
                                        if ($(this).attr("parentid") == "0") {
                                            $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").append("<option value='" + $(this).attr("flid") + "'>" + $(this).html() + "</option>");
                                        }
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        },
                        error: function (response) {
                            alert(response);
                        }
                    });
                }
                return false;
            }
        });

    }

    function removeFolder(val) {
        if (confirm("Bạn muốn xóa  thư mục này?")) {
            var FolderID = $(val).attr("FID");
            var params = "FolderID=" + FolderID;
            var parent = $(val).parent();
            $.ajax({ 'url': '/page/ajaxcontroler.aspx',
                'data': params + '&action=DeleteFolder',
                'type': 'POST',
                success: function (response) {
                    if (response != "") {
                        if (response.substr(0, 3) == "Err") {
                            alert(response.substr(3));
                        }
                        else {
                            parent.remove();

                            $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").html("<option value='0'>Chọn thư mục cha</option>");
                            $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul li label").each(function myfunction() {
                                if ($(this).attr("parentid") == "0") {
                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").append("<option value='" + $(this).attr("flid") + "'>" + $(this).html() + "</option>");
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                },
                error: function (response) {
                    alert(response);
                }
            });
        }

        return false;
    }
    function luutrufolder() {

        var Flder = "";
        $("#FavoriteFolderfrom .Fcheckbox").each(function myfunction() {
            if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
                Flder += "[" + $(this).attr("FID") + "]";
            }
        });

        var params = "LawID=" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #FavoriteLawID").val() + "&Type=Add&Flder=" + Flder;

        $.ajax({ 'url': '/page/ajaxcontroler.aspx',
            'data': params + '&action=AddOrDeleteMyDoc',
            'type': 'POST',
            success: function (response) {
                $("#FavoriteFolderfrom").dialog("close");
                location.reload();
            },
            error: function (response) {

            }
        });
    }
</script>

            var names = [];

            $('.content1').find('a').each(function () {
                var name = $(this).attr('name');
                if (name.startsWith('tvpllink_')) {
                    var underscoreIndex = name.indexOf('_', name.indexOf('_') + 1);
                    if (underscoreIndex !== -1) {
                        name = name.substring(0, underscoreIndex);
                    }

                    if (!processedNames[name]) {
                        names.push(name);
                        processedNames[name] = true;
                    }
                }
            });

            //console.log(names);

            if (names != undefined && names != null && names.length > 0) {

                var listLink = names.toString();

                console.log("listLink");
                console.log(listLink);
                
                $.ajax(
                { 'url': 'https://json.thuvienphapluat.vn/Document/GetListDocumentLink',
                    'data': 'ListLink=' + listLink,
                    'type': 'GET',
                    success: function (response) {
                        console.log("5435");
                        console.log(response);
                        var ret = response;
                        console.log(ret);
                        if (ret != undefined && ret != null && ret.length > 0) {
                            for (var i = 0; i < ret.length; i++) {
                                var codeLink = ret[i].CodeLink;
                                var link = ret[i].Link;
                                $(".content1 a[name*='" + codeLink + "']").attr("href", link).attr("target", "_blank").css({
                                    "color": "#0E70C3",
                                    "cursor": "pointer"
                                }); ;

                        }
                    },
                    error: function (response) {
                        console.log(response);
                    }
                });
            }

                $(".divmlcontent ul li.lever-1").css({ "list-style-type": "none", "padding-left": "5px", "margin": "0" });

            });

            $(".AddFolder").click(function myfunction() {
                if ($("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() == "") {
                    alert("Bạn phải nhập tên thư mục");
                    return false;
                }
                var params = "ParentID=" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").val() + "&FolderName=" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val();

                $.ajax({ 'url': '/page/ajaxcontroler.aspx',
                    'data': params + '&action=AddFolder',
                    'type': 'POST',
                    success: function (response) {
                        if (response != "") {
                            if (response.substr(0, 3) == "Err") {
                                alert(response.substr(3));
                            }
                            else {
                                var items = $.parseJSON(response);
                                if (items["ParentID"] == "0") {
                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul").append("<li><input class='Fcheckbox' name='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' fid='" + items["ID"] + "' id='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' type='checkbox' checked='checked'> <label for='Fcheckbox-" + items["ID"] + "' flid='" + items["ID"] + "' parentid='" + items["ParentID"] + "'>" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() + "</label> <a FID='" + items["ID"] + "'  onclick='removeFolder(this)'>Xóa</a></li>");
                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").append("<option value='" + items["ID"] + "'>" + $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #txtFolder").val() + "</option>");

                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom #fdParent").html("<option value='0'>Chọn thư mục cha</option>");
                                    $("#FavoriteFolderfrom ul li label").each(function myfunction() {
